title: SimpleStaffChat+
description: Simple lightweight staffchat plugin · Fully Configurable
body:
Simple lightweight plugin for StaffChat

**Features:**
- Fully Configurable
- Permissions
- Simple use
- LightWeight

**Commands:**
/staffchat [message] - send message to players with staffchat permission

**Config.yml**

```
# StaffChat Config File
# Plugin Version: 1.0
# Config Version: 1.0
# Plugin support: https://discord.gg/zYVtWxEar8

# Permissions:
StaffChatPermission: "staffchat.use"
# Messages:
StaffChatUsage: "&cUsage: /staffchat <message>"
StaffChatPrefix: "&7[§bStaffChat§7] &f"
```
